gui.neromaps.desk.title: Cartography Desk
gui.neromaps.desk.tab.label: Label
gui.neromaps.desk.tab.copy.tooltip: Copy a filled atlas (top slot, kept) into a blank atlas (lower slot). The copy has the blank's capacity.
gui.neromaps.desk.tab.merge.tooltip: Merge two filled atlases of the same dimension into one. Both are used.
gui.neromaps.desk.tab.label.tooltip: Give an atlas a label (24 characters, filtered like waypoint names).
gui.neromaps.desk.tab.print.tooltip: Print a wall map of the atlas's area (paper), or make a signpost (a sign).
gui.neromaps.desk.span.tooltip: How many blocks each wall-map panel covers. Bigger arrays show more area.
gui.neromaps.signpost.title: Signpost
gui.neromaps.signpost.label: Label
gui.neromaps.signpost.public.tooltip: Anyone near this signpost sees it and its label on their map. It never shows who wrote it.
chapter.neromaps.charting.title: Charting the World
quest.neromaps.charting.compass.title: True North, Your North
quest.neromaps.charting.compass.desc: Craft a Waypoint Compass. It points at the waypoints you set, and nobody else's.
quest.neromaps.charting.atlas.title: Pages to Fill
quest.neromaps.charting.atlas.desc: Craft a Blank Atlas. Use it to record the map you have explored.
quest.neromaps.charting.desk.title: The Cartographer's Bench
quest.neromaps.charting.desk.desc: Build a Cartography Desk to copy, merge and label atlases.
quest.neromaps.charting.wall_map.title: Maps on the Wall
quest.neromaps.charting.wall_map.desc: Collect a Wall Map. Print one at the desk to show an area to everyone who has explored it.
quest.neromaps.charting.signpost.title: This Way
quest.neromaps.charting.signpost.desc: Craft a Signpost: a public waypoint that anyone nearby sees on their map.
quest.neromaps.charting.trail.title: Breadcrumbs
quest.neromaps.charting.trail.desc: Craft Trail Markers to find your way back out of the deep caves.
quest.neromaps.charting.table.title: A Table of Terrain
quest.neromaps.charting.table.desc: Craft a Map Table to see your surroundings laid out in glass.
gui.neromaps.settings.title: NeroMaps settings
gui.neromaps.settings.reset_tab.tooltip: Put back every setting as it was when you opened this screen.
gui.neromaps.settings.tab.minimap.toolti: Shape, size, zoom, border, rotation and where the minimap sits.
gui.neromaps.settings.tab.style.tooltip: How the map is coloured, and the grid, chunk borders and cave mode.
gui.neromaps.settings.tab.readouts.toolt: The lines of text under the minimap.
gui.neromaps.settings.tab.waypoints.tool: Waypoint markers, beams, distance labels and death points.
gui.neromaps.settings.tab.presets.toolti: Apply, save, share and import whole sets of these settings.
High contrast, colour-blind-safe palettes and reduced motion.
gui.neromaps.settings.minimap.enabled.to: Show the minimap. The world map works either way.
gui.neromaps.settings.minimap.shape.tool: Square or round. Round maps come in 64, 96, 128 and 160.
gui.neromaps.settings.minimap.size.toolt: Width of the map in GUI pixels.
gui.neromaps.settings.minimap.zoom.toolt: Blocks per pixel. The zoom keys change it in play.
gui.neromaps.settings.minimap.rotation.t: On: the map turns so you always face up. Off: north is always up.
gui.neromaps.settings.minimap.anchor.too: Which corner the minimap sits in. Top right moves down below status effects.
gui.neromaps.settings.minimap.margin.too: Space kept between the minimap and the screen edge.
gui.neromaps.settings.style.style.toolti: Day / Night: true colours that darken at night. Biome: one colour per biome. Height: colour by height with contours. Flat: plain colours. High contrast: four grey bands and bold water.
gui.neromaps.settings.style.night.toolti: Day / Night style: darken the map from dusk to dawn.
gui.neromaps.settings.style.grid.tooltip: Draw a grid line every 16 blocks.
gui.neromaps.settings.style.cave.tooltip: Underground, show a slice at your height instead of the surface.
gui.neromaps.settings.readouts.time.tool: The time of day in this world.
gui.neromaps.settings.readouts.light.too: The block light where you stand.
gui.neromaps.settings.waypoints.on_minim: Show your waypoints as markers on the minimap.
gui.neromaps.settings.waypoints.beams.to: Show waypoint beams in the world.
gui.neromaps.settings.waypoints.beam_ran: Beams farther away than this are hidden.
gui.neromaps.settings.waypoints.distance: Show how far each waypoint is.
gui.neromaps.settings.waypoints.death_po: Show where you last died (the last three).
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.compact.to: A small round map that turns with you. No readouts.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.explorer.t: The default: a square north-up map with coordinates and biome.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.builder.to: A large flat map with grid and chunk borders, coordinates, facing and light.
A faint round map with a thin border, no readouts and no beams.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.off.toolti: No minimap. The world map still opens with its key.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.user.toolt: Your own preset. Click to apply it.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.name: Preset name
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.name.toolt: A name for your preset (letters, digits, spaces, - and _).
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.save_as.to: Save the current settings under the name on the left.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.save_faile: That name is empty, already used by a built-in preset, or the list is full.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.rename.too: Give your current preset the name in the box.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.export.too: Copy the current settings to the clipboard as preset text.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.import.too: Apply preset text from the clipboard. Only display settings are read.
gui.neromaps.settings.presets.cycle_hint: Bind "Cycle preset" in Controls to switch presets in play.
gui.neromaps.settings.accessibility.high: Forces the high-contrast map style and frames.
gui.neromaps.settings.accessibility.pale: Both palettes are colour-blind safe. Markers also differ by shape and symbol.
gui.neromaps.settings.accessibility.redu: No pulsing markers, no zoom easing.
gui.neromaps.settings.accessibility.keyl: A white outline around every marker.
gui.neromaps.settings.accessibility.subt: Every NeroMaps sound has a subtitle (Options > Accessibility).
gui.neromaps.worldmap.search.tooltip: Show only waypoints whose name contains this text.
gui.neromaps.worldmap.go.tooltip: Centre the map on this waypoint.
gui.neromaps.worldmap.settings.tooltip: Open the NeroMaps settings: minimap, style, presets and accessibility.
neromaps.export.sent: Your NeroMaps data is on its way to your game. Look for it under neromaps/exports in your game folder.
neromaps.export.saved: Saved everything this server's NeroMaps holds about you to %s in your game folder.
neromaps.export.failed: Could not save your NeroMaps export.
neromaps.export.cooldown: You can export your NeroMaps data once a minute.
neromaps.export.too_large: Your NeroMaps record is too large to send in one export. Ask the server operator.
neromaps.export.no_client: Your game does not have NeroMaps installed, so the export cannot be saved on your side.
